Long panes now have a way to the top and bottom and show where you are: a button at each end and a position bar on the right edge. Slack conversations open at the newest message.

- desk-look, desk-slack, desk-asana, desk-review: when a pane is taller than its window, its first line carries `↓ Bottom · End` and its last line `↑ Top · Home`. They go where the End and Home keys go once the pane has the keyboard (a click on the pane, or the command that opens it); PgUp and PgDn page it. The activity pane, which pins its header and scrolls itself, is left as it is
- The same panes draw a position bar on their right edge: its thumb is the share of the pane in view, and it follows the wheel, the keys and the buttons. It shows position only; it cannot be clicked or dragged
- desk-slack: opening a conversation or a thread starts at the bottom, by the newest messages and the reply box, and sending a reply keeps you there. Reloading with `↻` leaves the pane where you were reading
- desk-review: a review finding is now fixed, left open or dismissed, and a real one carries how it was fixed or why it was left open, under its reason. The skill writes the whole report, including Not verified and Next, in the language you write in
- desk-plan and desk-grant move to 0.74.0 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
